title: Unlock the first robot after a day of watering, then the second after its first job
tier_reason: S-12 landed the top two rungs (bench, Mark III) on a ladder whose bottom two, ruled on 2026-09-04 under Q-88, were never built: today the mark-1 and the mark-2 are plain purchases with nothing but price between them, so a player can buy a reacting machine before ever using a pre-programmed one.
first_action: Read docs/design/06-bots-and-training.md, “Earning the first two robots,” then inspect SimWorld.offers, the water Action, and mark-1 action dispatch before editing.
ask: Implement the two Q-88 robot unlocks exactly as designed in docs/design/06-bots-and-training.md (“Earning the first two robots”). Mark-1: count successful player water Actions within one day and unlock after the 11th; reset the daily count at sleep. Count the normal 30-unit action cost rather than energy-meter change, so the phase-1 soft floor cannot alter the proof. Rain, sprinklers, bots, failed Actions, and refills do not count. Mark-2: unlock after a placed mark-1 successfully completes its first water or till Action on a taught tile. Buying, placing, teaching, sending out, refused Actions, and a no-op round do not count. Latch both unlocks in saved sim state so replay reproduces the same shop. On loading older saves, a mark-1 already owned in the crate or yard earns its rung; a mark-2 already owned earns both earlier rungs. Keep both robots in the shop catalogue as locked cards before proof and priced purchases after proof (150g/400g [Playtest]); shop display and buy_machine must use the same SimWorld.offers answer. Do not grant robots for free. Update focused sim tests, affected fixtures, and the existing comments or docs that describe the shelf. Run the full unit and integration suites; report their actual PASSED/FAILED totals. The previous attempts on this card used different triggers and their patch was not applied. Do not reuse that patch as the rule.
source_message: Filed by the chief of staff from Tomas's S-12 report, 2026-09-10.
result: Implemented 2026-09-23 in GitHub main commit 35714f2. Mk I unlocks after 11 successful player watering actions in one day; Mk II after a placed Mk I completes its first taught watering or hoeing action. The shop keeps both as locked cards until earned, then sells them at their existing prices. Save, replay, and old-owner migration preserve access. Both unlocks show a brief seed-box cue. Verified on the shared checkout: mainline unit 2,937 passed / 0 failed; integration 1,008 passed / 0 failed; gateway passed; end-to-end robot session replay matched autosave.

- Mark-2 requires a mark-1 to finish one complete round.

- Added the requested test and updated P-13.
